{{Quote|It's why I can't help Aubin deal with th' agony he's in. His mother could&mdash;until they killed her.|Goethar Kleej, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KotOR 40" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' and the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Goethar Kleej]] were the [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of the Gotal [[Aubin Kleej]]. Around when the [[Mandalorian Wars]] ignited, the woman and the rest of her family were captured by<ref name="KotOR 40" /> [[the Crucible]], a violent [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] organization.<ref name="KotOR 46">[[Knights of the Old Republic 46|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 46]]</ref> Aubin had difficulties sorting through the extra-sensory signals that Gotals received through their [[cones]], so he relied heavily on his mother to function on a [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] basis.<ref name="KotOR 40" />

Aubin's dependency was particularly pronounced after<ref name="KotOR 40" /> [[Chantique]], the [[Magister Impressor|leader]] of the enslavement ring,<ref name="KotOR 46" /> severed Goethar's horns, depriving him of cone-reliant sensory information and the ability to connect with his son on that level. The mother was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Crucible, resulting in her son's descent into silent agony. Around [[3963 BBY]], Goethar recounted the woman's death and its effect on their family to the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]].<ref name="KotOR 40" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aubin Kleej's mother was mentioned in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 40|fortieth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="KotOR 40" /> on [[April 22]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54359/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_40|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #40}}</ref>
